verses.text: Who has believed our message? To whom has the power of the LORD been shown?

He grew up before the LORD like a tender young plant, like a root coming up out of dry ground. He was not handsome or majestic. There was nothing beautiful about his appearance that would draw us to him.
He was hated and rejected by people. He was a man of suffering who knew what sickness was. He was like someone people turn their faces away from. He was hated, and we did not think much of him.
Yet surely he took up our sickness and carried our pain. But we thought he was being punished by God, struck down by him, and made to suffer.
But he was pierced because of our rebellion. He was crushed because of our sins. He was punished so that we could have peace, and by his wounds we are healed.
All of us, like sheep, have wandered away. Each of us has turned to go our own way. And the LORD has laid on him the sins of us all.
He was treated cruelly, yet when he suffered, he did not open his mouth. He was led like a lamb to be killed. And as a sheep is silent before those who cut off its wool, he did not open his mouth.
He was arrested and judged unfairly, and taken away. Who among the people of his time cared? He was cut off from the land of the living. He was struck down for the rebellion of my people.
He was given a grave with the wicked, and he was with a rich man in his death, even though he had done nothing violent and had never spoken a lie.
Yet it was the LORD's will to crush him and make him suffer. When his life is made an offering for sin, he will see his children and live a long life. And the LORD's plan will succeed through him.
After he has suffered, he will see the light of life and be satisfied. By what he knows, my righteous servant will make many people right with God, and he will carry their sins.

So I will give him a share among the great, and he will divide the prize with the strong. For he poured out his life to death, and he was counted among the rebels. He carried the sins of many and prayed for the rebels.
